class.name: DismemberedLimb
class.brief_description: A detached limb created by a dismemberment component.
class.description: Holds the detached meshes and manages the limb's physics and lifetime.

members.member: Name of the bone at the root of the detached limb. The dismemberment component sets it when creating the limb.
Time in seconds before the detached limb removes itself. Use [code]0[/code] to keep it until it is removed by the component or the scene.
